## 说明

该函数把每个FAO海洋渔区的渔获量分为两部分：濒临该渔区的国家（沿岸国）和不濒临该渔区的国家（远洋捕捞船队），并展示主要远洋捕捞国的渔获量随时间的变化。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function splits the catch in each FAO marine fishing area between countries that border
the area (coastal countries) and countries that do not (distant-water fleets), and shows the
main distant-water countries over time.

</details>

## 用法

```r
coastal_distant(
  area_data,
  top_n = 8,
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE),
  label = NULL
)
```

## 参数

`area_data`
:   FAO渔获数据：`fishing_area_data()$area_data`，或`load_fao_data()`的任意子集（例如一个国家，或几个渔区）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    FAO catch data: `fishing_area_data()$area_data`, or any subset of
    `load_fao_data()` (e.g. one country, or several fishing areas).

    </details>

`top_n`
:   单独显示的远洋捕捞国数量。默认为8。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The number of distant-water countries shown separately. Default is 8.

    </details>

`plot`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，图表保存在figures/png/summary/。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE (default), charts are saved in `figures/png/summary/`.

    </details>

`table`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in `tables/`.

    </details>

`lang`
:   图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or
    "both" (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with
    `fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).

    </details>

`pptx`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/summary/。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE, charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files in
    `figures/pptx/summary/`. Default is FALSE, which can be changed for all functions with
    `fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`.

    </details>

`label`
:   输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为数据所属的渔区（或国家）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The name used in the output file names. Default is the fishing area (or the
    country) of the data.

    </details>

## 返回值

以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含`yearly`（沿岸国和远洋捕捞国的渔获量）、`distant`（各远洋捕捞国的渔获量）和`table`。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

Invisibly, a list with `yearly` (catch by coastal and distant-water countries),
`distant` (catch by distant-water country) and `table`.

</details>

## 详细说明

若一个国家的陆地（包括海外领土）位于FAO渔区边界20 km以内，即视为该渔区的沿岸国（见`data-raw/build_coastal_countries.R`）。苏联等已不存在的国家采用其继承国的海岸线。以"Other nei"上报的渔获量显示为未知。内陆渔区不纳入分析。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

A country is coastal to an area if its land, including overseas territories, lies within 20 km
of the FAO area boundary (see `data-raw/build_coastal_countries.R`). Former countries such as
the USSR take the coastline of their successor states. Catch by "Other nei" is shown as unknown.
Inland fishing areas are left out.

</details>

## 示例

```r

coastal_distant(FAO34$area_data, lang = "zh")
```
